title: Android export and on-device regression gate

confirmed_before_starting.question: does A4 collide with the colleague's in-progress D2 (PrepUI split)?
confirmed_before_starting.evidence: A4 adds tools/android_smoke.sh and edits export_presets.cfg only. It reads no scene under scenes/prep/ and writes no script the D2 split touches.

new_tool.why_not_the_editor_remote_deploy: Remote Deploy only answers 'does it start'. It installs a throwaway APK with no hash, no commit link, no logcat and no screenshot. A4's entire point is traceability: every QA APK must be traceable back to a source commit and an asset manifest.

passing_run.note: Debug 构建，仅用于 QA。不得当作 Release 验收：没有私有 keystore 签名、没有体积门槛、没有低端机与双设备联机验收。

install_findings.streamed_install_wedges_adbd: A 694 MiB `adb install` drove the device's adbd to 'offline'; afterwards even `adb shell` failed until USB debugging was toggled on the phone. The script now sends any APK >= 300 MiB straight to `adb push` + `pm install` and never attempts streamed install for those.
install_findings.transport_still_drops_after_the_push: Even with push + pm install, the transport went offline right after the 694 MiB transfer in 2 of 3 runs, on both USB and wireless. The install itself succeeded (pm install printed Success, and dumpsys showed lastUpdateTime updating); it was only the follow-up verification that could not reach the device.
install_findings.msys_path_conversion: Git Bash rewrote the device-side path /data/local/tmp/... into a Windows path. Every device-path adb call is now prefixed with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1.

false_results_found_and_fixed.what: The script reported pid / memory / zero-errors after an install that had failed, because monkey happily launched the older build already on the device.
false_results_found_and_fixed.fix: If FAILURES is non-empty after the install step, the script writes an early smoke.json with stopped_before=launch and never launches. A successful-looking launch of a stale build is worse than no result.

false_results_found_and_fixed.what: A run reported not_installed because `pm path` failed - but the package was installed; the adb transport had dropped after the push.
false_results_found_and_fixed.fix: _wait_transport() polls `adb get-state` for up to 60s (attempting `adb reconnect`) before the check, and a still-unreachable device now reports device_lost_after_install instead of not_installed.

false_results_found_and_fixed.what: smoke.json was not valid JSON. `set -o pipefail` plus `grep -v` returning non-zero on no-match made the `|| echo '[]'` fallback fire as well, emitting two `[]` lines; Python's text-mode stdout on Windows added CR; and Python decoded the bash-supplied UTF-8 failure strings with the ANSI codepage, turning the Chinese reasons into mojibake.
false_results_found_and_fixed.fix: The failure list is built by a single Python call that reads stdin as binary, decodes UTF-8 explicitly, and writes the JSON back out as binary with ensure_ascii=False. The script then parses its own smoke.json and fails with evidence_unparseable if it cannot - evidence nobody can read is not evidence. The broken artefact is kept at A4_android_smoke_20260820/broken_evidence_before_fix/.

false_results_found_and_fixed.what: If the failure-list encoder had died, the fallback wrote failures:[] - claiming zero failures on a failing run.
false_results_found_and_fixed.fix: The fallback is now ["failure_list_encoding_error"]. An empty list is only ever written when there genuinely were no failures.

false_results_found_and_fixed.what: export_presets.cfg is gitignored (line 5) and the root copy has never been in git, so A5's exclude_filter does not travel with the repo. A fresh clone exports with an empty filter and silently packs backups/, *.bak and Demo_GodotVFX into the APK. The export still reports success; the APK is just hundreds of MB larger.
false_results_found_and_fixed.fix: The script checks for a non-empty exclude_filter before exporting and stops with stopped_before=export rather than producing the bad APK. Verified against the real file (passes), a file with exclude_filter="" (blocks), and a missing file (blocks).

skip_install_rationale: Re-pushing 694 MiB is what destabilises adbd, so --skip-install exists to avoid it. It is not permission to trust whatever is on the phone: it computes sha256sum of the on-device base.apk and compares it byte-for-byte with the local APK, failing with skip_install_hash_mismatch otherwise. Skipping the install is allowed; skipping 'the device is running exactly this APK' is not.

apk_composition.correction: An earlier claim in this session - that shipping arm64 only would meaningfully shrink the APK - was wrong. Dropping armeabi-v7a saves 27.9 MiB (4.0%) and gives up every 32-bit device. 92% of the APK is assets.
apk_composition.not_duplicate_formats: Only 4 source images exist in both forms; 291 are ETC2-only and 377 are non-ETC2-only. The non-ETC2 set is UI/background art imported with Godot's 2D default (Lossless), i.e. never VRAM-compressed at all.
apk_composition.largest_single_lever: dark_dragon.glb (53.5 MiB), dark_scythe.glb (39.4 MiB) and dark_fear.glb (31.3 MiB) come to 124.2 MiB after import - 17.9% of the whole APK in three files.

fbx_finding.consequence: README's 'move FBX sources out of the runtime tree' item has zero APK-size benefit: Godot only packs .godot/imported/ artifacts, so the sources never shipped. It is a repo-hygiene and licence-traceability item, not a size one.
